decisions.reason: This electrometer sits squarely in the firm's core dosimetry, calibration, and radiation-therapy QA knowledge base and is presented as a flagship product, so its absorptive capacity to improve and commercialize it is very strong.

The oncology risk management software is adjacent to the firm's established QA software, workflow, and clinical support capabilities, so although it is less central than Product A, the firm is still well positioned to learn from early use and refine it rather than withdraw it.
